cards.headline: Grid, Storage & Electrification leads, Refining & Downstream lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Grid, Storage & Electrification at +4.11%; weakest is Refining & Downstream at -7.49%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.
